# A button given its url after construction renders no link target

## Context

neomjs/neo-agent-institution#840 reports that the Fleet Manager Observatory's "Open on GitHub" opens nothing and severs the window's port to the app worker. The root cause is traced in [#840 comment 6640019249](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/840#issuecomment-6640019249):
- The button gets its `url` after construction, so it renders `<a href>` with no `target`.
- The click navigates the window itself, and `beforeunload` departs it: `Neo.main.DomEvents.onBeforeUnload` broadcasts `disconnect`.
- The desktop shell then cancels the external navigation, which leaves a page that no longer updates.

A probe on the engine's unit setup, `dev` `3ed29de673`, run from a scratch script outside the tree:

```
button                        tag  href     rendered target  urlTarget config
url set after construction    a    the URL  none             _blank
url at construction           a    the URL  _blank           _blank
```

## The Problem

`Neo.button.Base` writes `target` only in `afterSetUrlTarget`. That hook runs at construction, while `url` is still `null`, and deletes the attribute. `afterSetUrl` runs `updateTag()`, which sets `href` and the `a` tag but never `target`. So any button that receives its `url` later renders a same-window link while its `urlTarget` still reads `_blank`. A selection-driven "Open" action is the typical case. In a browser tab the click navigates the app away. In a shell that cancels external navigations, the window is left disconnected from its app worker.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/button/Base.mjs`: `afterSetUrlTarget` sets `vdomRoot.target` only when `me.url` is set. `updateTag()` owns the root's polymorphic, tag-owned attributes (`href`, the tag, and native `disabled` since PR #15327), but not `target`.
- Design authority: the `urlTarget_` JSDoc, "If url is set, applies the target attribute on the top level vdom node". The rendered state depends on config order instead.
- `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` covers a `url` set at construction ("should keep native disabled aligned with button-to-anchor transitions"), never one set later.

## The Fix

`updateTag()` reconciles `target` with the link it renders. An external `url` link takes `urlTarget` when that is set. A route link (`#…`) and the `button` tag carry none. `afterSetUrlTarget` delegates to `updateTag()`, so one owner decides every tag-owned attribute.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A button whose `url` is set after construction renders `target` equal to `urlTarget`, and clearing `url` removes it.
- [ ] AC-2: A route link (`route` with `editRoute: false`) renders no `target`. Changing `urlTarget` on a url button updates the rendered `target`.
- [ ] AC-3: `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` covers AC-1 and AC-2, with AC-1 red on `dev`. The existing suite passes.

## Out of Scope

- The Institution side of neomjs/neo-agent-institution#840: its `neo.mjs` lock bump and an e2e on the Observatory's Open.
- `rel="noopener"`, which browsers imply for `target="_blank"`.
- *Hypothesis, needs V-B-A before any ticket:* `DomEvents.onBeforeUnload` departs the window on a navigation that is later cancelled. This fix removes the trigger reported here, not that fragility.
